Nine centers
Head center — Open. Pressure to wonder and ask questions. This center can be shaped by people and places around you. With others: You may notice whose questions inspire you.
Ajna center — Open. Making ideas and thoughts from questions. This center can be shaped by people and places around you. With others: You may notice how other people shape your way of thinking.
Throat center — Defined. Speaking, sharing, and taking action. This center has steady energy in your chart. With others: You may notice how others invite you to speak or act.
Identity (G) center — Defined. Your sense of self, love, and direction. This center has steady energy in your chart. With others: You may notice how people affect your sense of direction.
Heart / Ego center — Open. Willpower, promises, and what you value. This center can be shaped by people and places around you. With others: You may notice whose goals or willpower affect you.
Spleen center — Defined. Quick instincts about safety and what is healthy. This center has steady energy in your chart. With others: You may notice how others affect your sense of safety.
Solar Plexus center — Open. Feelings, moods, and emotional waves. This center can be shaped by people and places around you. With others: You may notice and feel the emotions of people around you.
Sacral center — Defined. Life energy for work, play, and making things. This center has steady energy in your chart. With others: You may notice how other people affect your energy to respond.
Root center — Defined. Pressure to get moving and handle stress. This center has steady energy in your chart. With others: You may notice how other people affect your sense of urgency.
